scripts.fix-schema.ts: replace-in-file '/(;\s*if \()value === null/mg' '$1value === null || value.kind === ValueKind.NULL' generated/schema.ts --isRegex
scripts.codegen:gnosis: node render-templates.js gnosis && graph codegen && yarn fix-schema.ts
scripts.codegen:gnosis-goldsky: node render-templates.js xdai && graph codegen && yarn fix-schema.ts
scripts.publish:gnosis-goldsky: yarn build:gnosis-goldsky && yarn goldsky subgraph deploy legacy-curate-gnosis/v${npm_package_version}
scripts.codegen:mainnet: node render-templates.js mainnet && graph codegen && yarn fix-schema.ts
scripts.codegen:goerli: node render-templates.js goerli && graph codegen && yarn fix-schema.ts
scripts.publish:goerli: yarn build:goerli && graph deploy --product hosted-service kleros/curate-goerli
scripts.codegen:sepolia: node render-templates.js sepolia && graph codegen && yarn fix-schema.ts
scripts.lint: yarn lint:eslint && yarn lint:prettier && yarn lint:secrets
